Scholarships: Canada-Colombia Scholarships: Canada-Colombia Looking to fund your studies in Canada? Both Colombia and Canada offer scholarships to help you pursue your education. Featured scholarships Postsecondary students can get funding for short-term study or research exchanges in Canadian institutions through the Emerging Leaders in the Americas Program (ELAP) Highly qualified doctoral students can get funding through the Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarship Postdoctoral researchers can get funding through the Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships Program Professionals at the master’s and doctorate level can apply for the Colfuturo Scholarship Credit Program Find international scholarship opportunities from the Colombian Institute of Educational Loans and Technical Studies Abroad (Spanish only) Find international scholarship opportunities with from Colombia’s Department of Science, Technology and Innovation Many colleges and universities also offer scholarships for international students. For more information, please contact your institution directly. Search for scholarships Search for scholarships for students and researchers from Colombia.
